appDescription: A group drive app that keeps several cars traveling together and shares each driver's situation with the whole group.

function.name: SHARE_DRIVING_STATUS
function.description: Share the driver's current situation with every car in the group drive.

status.description: The situation to share: SLEEPY when the driver feels drowsy, REST when the driver wants a break, TOILET when the driver needs a restroom, FUEL when the car needs fuel or charging.

function.name: SEND_GROUP_MESSAGE
function.description: Send a short text message to every member of the group drive.

message.description: The message text to send to the group, kept in the language the user spoke.

function.name: ANSWER_REST_VOTE
function.description: Answer the ongoing group vote about stopping at a rest area.

answer.description: YES to agree to stop at the proposed rest area, NO to keep driving.
